It preserves non-negativity and adheres to the evaluator's constraints, addressing the core challenge of optimizing a non-convex objective over a large search space without excessive memory usage. The method relies on FFT-based convolution for efficiency and logarithmic-axis transforms to maintain numerical stability during descent.
